Jean Baptiste Moreau was born on 12 March 1821 in Bastogne, in what is now the Belgian province of Luxembourg, and died there on 3 October 1889. The tree shows them as parents of both children, but there is no husband-and-wife relationship connecting them to each other, and no marriage record or date anywhere in the data. Jean Baptiste has a precise birth date (12 March 1821). His wife and both children are recorded with year only — "1825," "1848," "1851." Belgium's civil registration system was already running by those years and would have recorded exact dates; these year-only entries suggest the records have not been fully consulted yet.

Jean Baptiste has no parents in the tree at all. His birth in 1821 falls squarely within the period covered by both Belgian civil registration and earlier church records for the Bastogne area, so his parents' identities are very likely findable.
